answer: The strongest single control I know for this is audio spectrogram watermark for spoken answers, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 554 aliases would need 554 separate proofs, each costing about 98 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The meadow test is the live device, the terrace test is the locked stake, and the plume test is the graded history no template can fake. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
